findings.description: A file:// page can make network requests to arbitrary origins. This is a high-impact WebView misconfiguration.
findings.recommendation: Keep allowUniversalAccessFromFileURLs disabled and serve local content from a constrained WebViewAssetLoader origin when possible.
findings.title: File URLs can access arbitrary origins

findings.description: A page loaded from file:// can read other file:// resources, which can expose local app or device files.
findings.recommendation: Keep allowFileAccessFromFileURLs disabled and avoid loading untrusted file:// pages.
findings.title: File URLs can access other file URLs

findings.description: The WebView allows HTTPS pages to load cleartext HTTP subresources, weakening transport security.
findings.recommendation: Use MIXED_CONTENT_NEVER_ALLOW unless a documented legacy compatibility case exists.
findings.title: Mixed content is always allowed

findings.description: The WebView can access local files. Combined with file URLs, content injection, or permissive bridge methods, this can expose app-private data.
findings.recommendation: Disable file access unless the app has a specific local-content use case.
findings.title: File access is enabled

findings.description: JavaScript is enabled in a WebView. This is expected for hybrid apps, but it increases the impact of untrusted content, XSS, and exposed JavaScript bridges.
findings.recommendation: Only enable JavaScript for trusted content and pair it with strict origin checks before exposing native bridges.
findings.title: JavaScript execution is enabled

findings.description: WebView Safe Browsing was disabled, reducing protection against known malicious URLs.
findings.recommendation: Leave Safe Browsing enabled unless there is a documented compatibility reason.
findings.title: Safe Browsing is disabled

findings.description: The WebView can load content:// resources. This can become risky when untrusted content can influence loaded URLs.
findings.recommendation: Disable content access unless required and validate all content:// URLs before loading them.
findings.title: Content provider access is enabled

findings.description: Geolocation support is enabled in WebView content.
findings.recommendation: Only allow geolocation for trusted origins and ensure prompts are not auto-approved.
findings.title: Geolocation is enabled

findings.description: JavaScript is allowed to open windows without user gestures, which can enable unwanted navigation flows.
findings.recommendation: Disable automatic window opening unless required by trusted content.
findings.title: JavaScript can open windows automatically
